tracking: ADR-0361 (lane E42): API-only by the lane brief (master dispatch 2026-11-17: new routes go in the census with a KNOWN_UI_GAPS entry pointing at #453, no screens); the AI SaaS monitoring screen is posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/ai-saas-monitoring: reads the AI SaaS monitoring policy, the vendor catalogue and every connector (credentials never returned)
gaps.PUT /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/policy: turns AI SaaS monitoring on or off and sets redacted content capture (each relaxation a settings_relax step-up; refused when air-gapped)
gaps.POST /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/connectors: registers a vendor tenant connector (disabled) with its schema-validated configuration and compliance tags
gaps.PUT /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/connectors/:c: changes a connector's configuration and compliance tags (widening an enabled connector is a step-up)
stores or rotates a connector's vendor secret (step-up, encrypted, never returned)
gaps.DELETE /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/connectors: revokes a connector's vendor secret and disables the connector (no step-up)
gaps.PUT /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/connectors/:c: enables (step-up, needs a live read-only credential) or disables a connector
gaps.POST /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/connectors/:: runs one compliance-export read now for a connector
gaps.GET /v1/ai-saas-monitoring/connectors/:c: lists a connector's runs, 50 at a time
lists a connector's recorded interactions and their counts-only findings, 100 at a time
